versions.name: RXV2-0.9.364-bench-polish
versions.notes: Travel extents polish: tail travel renamed to 'nose left / nose right' (a tail swinging left sends the NOSE right — plain left/right labels mislead), and the bench buttons grey out when meaningless: Hold is disabled while that exact hold is already active, Release is disabled when nothing is held.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.363-bench-official
versions.notes: Verified against the Rotorflight source: the Bench measure IS Rotorflight's own official calibration method (their configurator sends the identical command). Collective removed from the bench axis picker — on this fleet it is calibrated the direct full-stick way, because the transmitter channel span is part of that story. Swash trims relabelled to % (Rotorflight's actual unit — they were mislabelled degrees).

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.362-bench-zeroed
versions.notes: Bench measure fix (Malcolm's own diagnosis, first try: 8 deg roll measured -24!): while holding one axis, the OTHER swash axes are now held at ZERO instead of following the live mixer — with no transmitter, collective was sitting at full-low underneath the measurement. A pure 8 deg roll now measures as just that.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.361-bench-measure
versions.notes: Bench measure on Travel extents: hold the swash at an exact angle with the gyros bypassed (Rotorflight's mixer override) so a pitch gauge can calibrate CYCLIC gain from the phone — no laptop. Pick Roll/Pitch/Collective and an angle, 'Hold this angle', measure the PEAK reading while rotating the head, then gain = current x commanded/peak. Guarded: refuses while armed, the FC refuses to arm while held, released on leaving the page and by a 5-minute auto-release. A step toward the full phone setup wizard.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.360-plain-english
versions.notes: Plain English across ALL Rotorflight screens (Malcolm: brilliant technicians were frequently simply not taught good English!). Every cryptic label now says what it does, with Rotorflight's own term kept in brackets for cross-reference: 'Hold cyclic true in pirouettes (piro comp)', 'Roll wind-up relief (I-term relax cutoff)', 'Stick sharpening (setpoint boost gain)', 'Tail-torque assist strength (TTA gain)', 'Throttle anticipation (feed-forward weights)', 'Quick-restart time (recovery time)', and friends — 45 labels in all.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.359-plain-names
versions.notes: Plainer words on Travel extents (Malcolm: Rotorflight's own names make it impenetrable — 'geo correction' sounds like GPS!): the field is now 'Collective up/down balance', with a note giving Rotorflight's name for cross-reference with their docs.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.358-geo-correction
versions.notes: Travel extents: new Geo correction field — Rotorflight's knob for unequal positive vs negative collective (Black Thunder II read +12.6 up but -14.9 down after gain calibration). Step it one way, re-measure, reverse if the gap widens; direction of every control is still preserved.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.357-travel-gains
versions.notes: Travel extents gains: new 'Calibration (gains)' card with collective and cyclic gain (%) — the scale that makes commanded degrees equal REAL measured degrees. Malcolm's first live read showed the FC commanding 14 deg while the blades reached only 5-7: raise the gain by the measured ratio (direction is always preserved — only the amount changes), use collective trim to centre a non-zero mid-stick, then re-measure.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.356-travel-extents-2
versions.notes: Travel extents fixes: mixer inputs are now read one at a time (the bulk read could never fit through the radio link, which is why the first version failed to load), and the status message is sticky at the top of the screen so it stays visible next to the Reload/Save buttons.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.355-travel-extents
versions.notes: NEW: 'Travel extents' screen in the Rotorflight menu — born at the field when Black Thunder II's first hover showed nowhere near enough collective pitch. Edit the collective pitch limit, cyclic pitch limit, total swash limit, swashplate trims and tail travel (Rotorflight 2.3 mixer limits) right from the phone. Changes apply immediately (no reboot), are saved to the flight controller's memory, and are verified by read-back. Always check new extents on the bench before flying.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.354-honest-flight-notes
versions.notes: Two flight-screen fixes from Black Thunder II's first flights: the yellow note now says Rotorflight screens were VIEWED (or edited) from the transmitter — just browsing screens fires parameter reads, so it no longer claims edits you never made. And the Black box status keeps showing the battery's LAST-KNOWN voltage (greyed, with its age) after the model powers down — exactly when you check the packs landed at 3.80 V/cell — instead of going blank.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.353-install-progress-bar
versions.notes: The manual install screen now shows a moving progress bar (like the front-page update prompt) with a phase note that switches to 'flashing + rebooting' when the receiver goes quiet — no more bare seconds counter during the wait.
